inference_latency.note: In-process, single prediction, no HTTP. The optimization folds the StandardScaler + LogisticRegression pipeline into one weight vector (P = sigmoid(w.x + b)) and drops per-request pandas DataFrame construction.

notes: Measured on an 8-core dev machine. An earlier httpx-based async client reported ~488 rps / 62ms p50, but that was client-bound (client and server contending for CPU on one box); ApacheBench is the authoritative figure. Predictions are byte-identical before and after the kernel optimization.
